slides: Staking lets you earn rewards for helping secure a blockchain network.
You lock up crypto to support validation and receive periodic rewards.
Higher rewards often mean higher risk so check the network before staking.
Use trusted platforms verify lockup terms and keep keys safe.
en.caption:
